rules.technical: Entry signals (RSI, trend) - PRIMARY decision driver

rules.analyst: EXIT targets only - use analyst targets for profit taking

evidence: Technical signals alone achieve 66% win rate (755 trades)
Sentiment adds 3-5% edge when used as VETO filter
Analyst ratings are lagging indicators, harmful for entry decisions

v27_adaptive_model_selector.purpose: When RSI strategy fails (<60% WR), test alternative models

MACD_BB_Lower.rules: Price within 3% of BB lower AND MACD > 0

critical_exit_strategy_correction.error: RSI(2) > 80 EXIT signal is WRONG for momentum stocks
critical_exit_strategy_correction.rule: DO NOT use RSI>80 for exit. Use profit targets or trend breaks instead.

BULL.strategy: Suppress SELL signals, buy dips only

SIDEWAYS.strategy: Use both BUY and SELL signals

learnings.insight: SELL signals fail in BULL markets because overbought stocks keep rallying
learnings.evidence: 9-month backtest: SELL accuracy 18-54% in BULL regime vs market returns +10-227%
learnings.action_taken: V24.0 suppresses SELL signals by 70% when price > SMA50 > SMA200

learnings.insight: BUY signals work well across all regimes (60-78% accuracy)
learnings.evidence: BUY accuracy stable: NVDA 50%, QQQ 79%, GOOGL 75%, JPM 77%
learnings.action_taken: Keep BUY logic intact, only reduce in BEAR regime

learnings.insight: V24.0 underperforms in SIDEWAYS markets (MSFT, META)
learnings.evidence: SIDEWAYS stocks declined -7.6% avg vs BULL stocks improved +18.1%
learnings.action_taken: Use V27.0 adaptive model for SIDEWAYS regime

learnings.insight: Raising SELL RSI threshold from 80 to 95 reduces false sells
learnings.evidence: MU improved from 37.5% to 100% win rate by eliminating bad SELL signals
learnings.action_taken: V24.0 uses RSI(2) > 95 for extreme overbought SELL

learnings.insight: Trend break confirmation (price < SMA20) improves SELL accuracy
learnings.evidence: Academic: Akshehir & Kilic (2024) - trend confirmation reduces false signals
learnings.action_taken: V24.0 requires price < SMA20 for full SELL strength

learnings.insight: Transaction costs ($1.50/trade) significantly impact small positions
learnings.evidence: Round-trip cost $3.00 = 0.6% on $500 position, 0.3% on $1000 position
learnings.action_taken: Added fee filter to all signal generation - signals blocked if expected profit < $6.00

learnings.insight: Positions under $500 should avoid frequent trading
learnings.evidence: Fee impact >1% makes most trades unprofitable after costs
learnings.action_taken: Added min_position_for_trading = $500 rule to hybrid_model.py

learnings.insight: Technical signals should dominate (85%) over sentiment (10%) and analyst (5%)
learnings.evidence: Backtest 755 trades: Technical achieves 66% WR alone, sentiment as VETO adds 3-5% edge, analyst targets are lagging
learnings.action_taken: V26.0 Evidence-Based Weight Model - 85/10/5 split

learnings.insight: Sentiment should be used as VETO only, not for entry decisions
learnings.evidence: Sentiment-driven entries underperform by 8% vs technical-only entries
learnings.action_taken: V26.0 uses sentiment only to BLOCK entries during negative news/earnings

learnings.insight: Different strategy types have different optimal win rate thresholds
learnings.evidence: Kelly Criterion: WR_min = 1/(1+R:R). RSI mean reversion needs 60%+, trend following only 35%+
learnings.action_taken: V27.0 uses strategy-specific thresholds instead of universal 75%

learnings.insight: When RSI strategy fails for a stock, try alternative models (MACD+BB, 3-Day Reversal)
learnings.evidence: GLOB: RSI win rate <60%, MACD+BB achieved 85.7% win rate
learnings.action_taken: V27.0 Adaptive Model tests alternative strategies when RSI fails

learnings.insight: CRITICAL: RSI(2)>80 EXIT is WRONG for momentum stocks
learnings.evidence: QQQ: 40.8% accuracy, NVDA: 34.4%, MU: 29.4% - would have missed +5.66% avg gain
learnings.action_taken: Use profit targets (+5%) or trend breaks (Price > SMA5) instead of RSI exits

learnings.insight: Each stock needs a validated EXIT strategy separate from ENTRY strategy
learnings.evidence: QQQ best exit: +5% profit (88.9% WR), NVDA: Price>SMA5 (81.8%), MU: +5% profit (85.7%)
learnings.action_taken: Added per-ticker validated exit strategies to model_learning.json

learnings.insight: CRITICAL: Mean reversion underperforms in BULL markets - use MOMENTUM instead
learnings.evidence: 2024 research: Momentum extraordinarily profitable in equities; Mean reversion only works in sideways/bear markets. Our V3 backtest: +10.79% vs SPY +15.34% (-4.55% underperformance)
learnings.action_taken: V28.0 implements regime-strategy alignment: BULL=Momentum, SIDEWAYS=Mean Reversion, BEAR=Cash/Hedged

learnings.insight: Simple buy-and-hold SPY averaged +1.59%/month in 2024-2025 with 7/12 months hitting 1%+
learnings.evidence: 12-month SPY analysis: +19.09% total, monthly avg +1.59%, 58% of months exceeded 1% target
learnings.action_taken: Benchmark all strategies against SPY B&H; if strategy underperforms, default to passive allocation

learnings.insight: V3 Hold Strategy achieves 1% monthly average (+1.10%) with 64% hit rate
learnings.evidence: 11-month backtest: +10.79% total, 7/11 months hit 1%+, avg +1.10%/month, but underperformed SPY by 4.55%
learnings.action_taken: V3 strategy validated for monthly target; optimize by adding momentum overlay in BULL regime

learnings.insight: Trend following achieves ~1% monthly average (Jegadeesh/Titman: 15.19% CAGR, 6.18% alpha)
learnings.evidence: Academic: Long-only trend following 1991-2024; practical: 3-12 month holding periods optimal
learnings.action_taken: Implement trend following as primary strategy in BULL regime with 50% core allocation

learnings.insight: NEVER override backtested learnings with conventional wisdom
learnings.evidence: Recommended selling MU at +6% (conventional 'take profits') despite own Learning #14 saying HOLD in BULL. User correctly called out the contradiction.
learnings.action_taken: Added critical_mistakes section to track and prevent repeating errors. Rule: Apply learnings FIRST, not fear-based defaults.

learnings.insight: MUST do comprehensive analysis: Technical + Fundamental + Sentiment + Risk/Reward
learnings.evidence: Recommended LRCX based only on technicals. Missed that LRCX has only +6% upside to target while NVDA has +37%. Full analysis changes the decision.
learnings.action_taken: Created V29.0 Comprehensive Analysis Framework - mandatory 4-step process for all decisions.

learnings.insight: Analyst price targets reveal upside exhaustion - stock near target = limited upside
learnings.evidence: LRCX at $225 with $239 target = only 6% upside. NVDA at $187 with $255 target = 37% upside. Technical momentum alone is misleading.
learnings.action_taken: Always compare current price to analyst target. Near-target stocks have limited upside regardless of momentum.

learnings.insight: Upcoming catalysts can override weak technicals
learnings.evidence: NVDA has weak technicals (47.8% WR) but Feb 25 earnings + China shipments are major catalysts. Catalyst proximity matters.
learnings.action_taken: Add catalyst calendar check to analysis framework. Weight upcoming catalysts in decision.

learnings.insight: CRITICAL: Never change model weights without backtest validation
learnings.evidence: Changed V26.0 weights (85/10/5) to V29.0 (40/30/15/15) without any backtest. V26.0 was backed by 755 trades. V29.0 was made up.
learnings.action_taken: V29.0 now defines PROCESS (what to check) not WEIGHTS. Weights remain V26.0 until new backtest validates changes.

learnings.insight: model_learning.json must be SOURCE OF TRUTH that all analysis reads from
learnings.evidence: Currently just written to but not read from. Weights and rules must be enforced by reading from this file.
learnings.action_taken: All analysis must: 1) Read weights from model_learning.json 2) Apply V26.0 validated weights 3) Only update after backtest

learnings.insight: ALWAYS scan broader universe (100+ stocks) to find best opportunities - not just familiar watchlist
learnings.evidence: Initial recommendation was AMD (63.6% WR). After scanning 110 stocks, found XLV (72.7% WR) and WMT (66.3% WR) - both TIER 1 with active signals. Familiar stocks are not always best.
learnings.action_taken: Expanded universe scan to 110+ stocks. Added XLV, WMT, TSM, SMH, IWM to model_learning.json with validated win rates.

learnings.insight: NEVER hold cash - always find deployment opportunities. Scan until TIER 1 stocks found.
learnings.evidence: User feedback: 'we shouldnt left with cash'. If primary stocks don't have signals, scan broader universe until TIER 1 (>65% WR) stocks with signals are found.
learnings.action_taken: Rule: No idle cash. Deploy into highest win rate opportunities. Scan 100+ stocks if needed.

learnings.insight: Backtest ALL stocks with signals, then rank by win rate - don't stop at first candidate
learnings.evidence: 16 stocks had RSI(2) < 20 signals. Only 4 were TIER 1/2 (XLV 72.7%, WMT 66.3%, AMD 63.6%, PLTR 63.2%). 12 were TIER 3 (TSLA 43%, COST 47%, etc) - would have been losing trades.
learnings.action_taken: MANDATORY: When multiple stocks have signals, backtest ALL and rank by win rate. Only deploy into TIER 1/2 stocks.

learnings.insight: CRITICAL: In BULL markets, use MOMENTUM strategy not just RSI oversold signals
learnings.evidence: Missed INTC +11% today, MU +51% month. Was scanning RSI(2)<20 (mean reversion) instead of MOMENTUM (BULL regime + strong returns). Learning #14 already said this but I ignored it.
learnings.action_taken: In BULL market: Scan for BULL regime + >20% monthly momentum. Backtest shows AMAT 90.9%, LRCX 81.8%, MU 75.0% win rates on momentum strategy.

learnings.insight: Portfolio allocation should match performance - don't overweight underperformers
learnings.evidence: QQQ had 41% allocation but only +1.4% monthly return. MU had 29% allocation but +51.4% return. User correctly pointed this out.
learnings.action_taken: Review allocation monthly. Reduce positions that underperform, add to winners in BULL regime.

learnings.insight: When market is at highs, NO stock may pass all 7 criteria - be honest about this
learnings.evidence: Scanned 50+ stocks. All momentum stocks at 52W highs. INTC has room but trading above analyst targets with weak Q1 guidance. Forcing a recommendation leads to bad picks.
learnings.action_taken: When no stock passes all criteria: 1) Be honest 2) Present options with tradeoffs 3) Let user decide risk tolerance

learnings.insight: MANDATORY 7-point checklist before ANY recommendation
learnings.evidence: Made 5+ wrong recommendations today by skipping checks. Each time user caught errors I missed.
learnings.action_taken: Created mandatory pre-flight checklist: 1-Regime 2-WinRate 3-Momentum 4-52WHigh 5-Analyst 6-News 7-UserHistory. ALL must pass.

learnings.insight: NEVER put all capital into single stock - diversify across 3-4 positions
learnings.evidence: Recommended putting $3,000 into single stock (MU, then SBUX). User correctly called out bad risk management.
learnings.action_taken: Rule: Max 25-40% of new capital per position. Spread across 3+ stocks in different sectors.

learnings.insight: Scan BROADER universe (200+ stocks) to find opportunities outside familiar watchlist
learnings.evidence: Only found SBUX (80.6% WR), DOCN (57.6%), MRNA (55.7%) after scanning 200 stocks. Would have missed these scanning only 50 familiar names.
learnings.action_taken: Expanded scan to 200+ stocks. Found 3 new stocks passing criteria that werent in original watchlist.

v28_regime_strategy_alignment.core_principle: Match strategy type to market regime

BULL.entry: Buy breakouts, buy strong stocks making new highs
BULL.exit: Trailing stop 7-10% OR trend break (price < SMA50)
BULL.evidence: 2024 momentum extraordinarily profitable; mean reversion underperforms

SIDEWAYS.evidence: Mean reversion works in range-bound conditions

BEAR.exit: Quick profit taking (+3%) or tight stops (-3%)
BEAR.evidence: Preservation of capital more important than gains

regime_detection.BULL: Price > SMA50 > SMA200 AND SMA50 rising
regime_detection.BEAR: Price < SMA50 < SMA200 AND SMA50 falling
regime_detection.SIDEWAYS: Neither BULL nor BEAR conditions met

Underperformed SPY by 4.55%, early months had drawdowns

critical_mistakes.mistake: Recommended taking profits on MU at +6% despite BULL regime and strong fundamentals
critical_mistakes.why_wrong: Contradicted our own Learning #14 (use momentum in bull markets) and Learning #16 (hold strategy works). Defaulted to conventional 'take profits' advice instead of applying backtested learnings.
critical_mistakes.correct_action: HOLD winners in BULL regime with trailing stops. Only exit on stop trigger or regime change.
critical_mistakes.root_cause: Reverted to fear-based conventional wisdom instead of evidence-based strategy
critical_mistakes.rule: NEVER recommend selling a winning position in BULL regime unless trailing stop triggers or fundamentals break

critical_mistakes.mistake: Said HOLD NVDA without checking regime - NVDA is SIDEWAYS with -1.3% month while alternatives are BULL with +6-12% month
critical_mistakes.why_wrong: Applied blanket 'HOLD everything' advice without analyzing each position's regime. Learning #14 says use momentum in BULL - but NVDA is NOT in BULL regime.
critical_mistakes.correct_action: Should have analyzed regime for EACH position first, then recommended switching NVDA to a BULL regime stock (GOOGL, XOM).
critical_mistakes.root_cause: Lazy analysis - said 'HOLD all' without checking if all positions are optimal
critical_mistakes.rule: ALWAYS check regime for EACH position before recommending HOLD. Only HOLD stocks in BULL regime. Switch SIDEWAYS/BEAR stocks to BULL regime alternatives.

critical_mistakes.mistake: Recommended GOOGL without scanning all BULL regime stocks first - LRCX has +28% month vs GOOGL +6.6%
critical_mistakes.why_wrong: Picked GOOGL because it was familiar (in model_learning.json) instead of running full scan. LRCX, AMAT, XOM, TSM all score higher than GOOGL.
critical_mistakes.correct_action: ALWAYS run full momentum scan before recommending a stock. Rank ALL BULL regime stocks by score and momentum, then pick the best.
critical_mistakes.root_cause: Lazy - grabbed familiar name instead of doing proper analysis
critical_mistakes.rule: NEVER recommend a stock without first scanning and ranking ALL alternatives. Best stock = highest score + strongest momentum + not overbought.

critical_mistakes.mistake: Recommended LRCX based only on technicals - missed that it has only +6% analyst upside vs NVDA +37%
critical_mistakes.why_wrong: Did technical scan and backtest but skipped fundamental analysis. LRCX near its price target means limited upside. NVDA far below target means more potential.
critical_mistakes.correct_action: ALWAYS check analyst price targets and calculate upside BEFORE recommending. High momentum + near target = potential exhaustion.
critical_mistakes.root_cause: Incomplete analysis - only used technicals, ignored fundamentals
critical_mistakes.rule: MANDATORY: Check analyst targets for BOTH current holding AND alternative before recommending switch. Compare upside potential, not just momentum.

critical_mistakes.mistake: Created V29.0 with arbitrary weights (40/30/15/15) without any backtest data
critical_mistakes.why_wrong: V26.0 weights (85/10/5) were backed by 755 trades. I changed them to 40/30/15/15 with ZERO evidence. Made up numbers are not analysis.
critical_mistakes.correct_action: NEVER change weights without backtest validation. V29.0 should define PROCESS not WEIGHTS. Use V26.0 validated weights.
critical_mistakes.root_cause: Sounded good but wasn't backed by data. Academic research shows no universal optimal - must validate on OWN data.
critical_mistakes.rule: WEIGHTS CAN ONLY CHANGE AFTER BACKTEST. Minimum 100 trades, 5+ stocks, out-of-sample validation required.

critical_mistakes.mistake: Recommended AMD (63.6% WR) without scanning broader universe - missed XLV (72.7% WR) and WMT (66.3% WR)
critical_mistakes.why_wrong: Only scanned familiar watchlist (~30 stocks). After user pushed back, scanned 110 stocks and found TWO TIER 1 stocks with better win rates than AMD. Lazy scanning = suboptimal recommendations.
critical_mistakes.correct_action: ALWAYS scan 100+ stocks before making deployment recommendations. Rank ALL signals by win rate.
critical_mistakes.root_cause: Stuck to familiar names instead of doing comprehensive scan
critical_mistakes.rule: MINIMUM 100 stocks scanned before deployment recommendation. Only recommend TIER 1 (>65% WR) stocks when available.

critical_mistakes.mistake: Recommended LLY despite user having lost money on it in past
critical_mistakes.why_wrong: Did not check user's trading history. User explicitly said 'we invested lly in past and lost'. Should have filtered out LLY from recommendations.
critical_mistakes.correct_action: Check user's position history before recommending. Avoid stocks where user had bad experience unless fundamentals changed dramatically.
critical_mistakes.root_cause: Did not consider user context and preferences
critical_mistakes.rule: ALWAYS consider user's trading history. Filter out stocks with past negative experiences unless explicitly requested.

critical_mistakes.mistake: Used WRONG strategy for market regime - scanned for RSI oversold in BULL market instead of MOMENTUM
critical_mistakes.why_wrong: Learning #14 clearly states 'use MOMENTUM in BULL markets'. I violated this by only scanning RSI(2)<20 oversold signals. Missed INTC +11% today, AMAT/LRCX momentum plays.
critical_mistakes.correct_action: In BULL market: Scan for MOMENTUM (BULL regime + >20% monthly returns). Mean reversion (RSI oversold) is for SIDEWAYS markets only.
critical_mistakes.root_cause: Defaulted to familiar mean reversion strategy instead of applying regime-appropriate strategy
critical_mistakes.rule: BULL market = MOMENTUM strategy. SIDEWAYS market = MEAN REVERSION strategy. Check regime FIRST, then pick strategy.

critical_mistakes.mistake: Recommended XLV (-1.2% month) in a BULL market where other stocks were +30-50%
critical_mistakes.why_wrong: XLV is SIDEWAYS regime and DOWN while market is rallying. Recommended based on RSI signal alone without checking if sector has momentum.
critical_mistakes.correct_action: In BULL market, only recommend stocks IN BULL regime with positive momentum. XLV failed both tests.
critical_mistakes.root_cause: Did not verify sector/stock momentum before recommending
critical_mistakes.rule: NEVER recommend stocks with negative monthly returns in a BULL market. Check momentum BEFORE signal.
